This is a Pre-Solicitioation. Response to this post is for inclusion in the oral solicitation at a later date. 

PRE-SOLICITATION

OFFUTT AFB 49 IS TROOP FEED BLANKET PURCHASE AGREEMENT 55 CONS/PKB – FA4600

106 PEACEKEEPER LN, STE 2N3, OFFUTT AFB, NE 68113

7 April 2026

Product/Service Code:               S203

NAICS Code:                           722310

Place of Performance:               Offutt AFB, Nebraska

Proposed Solicitation Number: Will be orally solicited outside of SAM.gov

Closing Response Date:                        24 April 2026

Proposed Solicitation Period:    Oral solicitation will be sent within 2 weeks of response date

Proposed Set-Aside:                                100% Total Small Business Set-Aside

DESCRIPTION

The 49 IS has an ongoing requirement for the acquisition of meals for troops on IDT/UTA. 55 CONS is planning on awarding a BPA to 1 respective contractor to fulfill this requirement. The delivery of any or all, at differing quantities, of the following products must be available per order of these BPAs:

  1. Breakfast
  2. Lunch
  3. Dinner
  4. Venga Breakfast
  5. Vegan Lunch
  6. Vegan Dinner
  7. Gluten Free Breakfast
  8. Gluten Free Lunch
  9. Gluten Free Dinner

The contractor must be able to deliver these items upon 15 day notice within specified 30 minute windows based on operational requirements. These items must be available for delivery twenty-four (24) hours per day, seven (7) days per week during winter operations (October – April yearly). Please see the Statement of Need (SoN) for more details on the scope of the proposed solicitation.

The total ordering period for these upcoming BPAs will be a five year ordering period from the date of award. Delivery will be made to Offutt AFB, Nebraska.

Offerors must be currently registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) and be a Small Business concern to be considered for award. If interested in this requirement, send notice to the individuals listed below and you will be included in the oral solicitation. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which shall be considered by the agency.

If you would like to be included in the oral solicitation please reach out via email to SSgt Eyvind Boyesen (eyvind.boyesen@us.af.mil)
